plugins.name: avontus-viewer
plugins.description: Estimate scaffold labor, and read bills of materials, weights and scaffold units, from your Avontus Viewer designs. Connects to the Avontus Viewer connector and adds a skill for estimating man-hours with your own Schedule of Norms.

skills.name: avontus-product-help
skills.description: Answer how-to and what-is questions about any Avontus product (Quantify, Designer, Viewer, ScaffoldIQ and others) from the official Avontus documentation. Use when the user asks how to do something in an Avontus product, what a feature or term means, or about scaffold inventory, rental, rates, billing, estimating or shipping, or asks for a new scaffold to be designed. Not for the contents of a specific design; see avontus-viewer-designs.

skills.name: avontus-viewer-designs
skills.description: Answer questions about scaffold designs in Avontus Viewer: bills of materials, part counts, weights, parts by elevation, scaffold units and previews. Use when the user asks about their scaffold designs, drawings, jobs or projects, or ones shared with them, with the Avontus Viewer connector.

skills.name: avontus-viewer-estimating
skills.description: Estimate scaffold labor (man-hours for erection, modification or dismantling) from a design in Avontus Viewer, using the user's own Schedule of Norms. Use when the user asks for man-hours, labor, crew time, minutes per piece or a labor estimate for a scaffold design, with the Avontus Viewer connector.
headings: Estimating scaffold labor from an Avontus Viewer design
